description: The coach's own account, as the app's billing panel and user menu show it: name and email, the plan (trial, which plan, renewal or cancellation), seats used against the plan's limit (on Coach Pro, the athletes above its twenty that are billed one by one), which athletes pay for their own plan and so cost no seat, the house rules (coaching_rules prose and rules_json, which set_coaching_rules replaces whole), the plans on offer with their monthly and yearly prices, and the link to open billing in the app. Card details are only ever typed in the app — send the coach the billing link to change plan.
name: get_account
